title: Khaemenes Academic Continuum
description: Shared public academic information contract for a free-to-learn Khaemenes educational continuum from early learning through advanced and research-level study.

access.courseMaterialsGoal: open public access wherever rights, privacy, safety, and technical requirements permit
access.credentialHonesty: Internal course records, assessments, portfolios, certificates, and completion records must not be described as externally accredited credentials unless that status has been independently established.

authority.subjectOwnershipRule: Each academic subject owns its discipline-specific continuum and standards.
authority.courseOwnershipRule: Each course owns its lessons, sequence, assessments, local records, and course-specific mastery decisions.
authority.sharedRule: The Academic Continuum coordinates public metadata, learning-stage vocabulary, subject discovery, evidence principles, accessibility expectations, and cross-disciplinary interoperability.
authority.archiveRule: ARSHIF preserves dated historical snapshots and is not a live runtime dependency.

institutionalPrinciples: Learning should remain accessible without lowering academic standards.
A course must clearly distinguish instruction, practice, assessment, evidence, interpretation, and certification.
AI assistance must not erase learner authorship or falsely certify mastery.
Sources, computation, observation, experiment, argument, and proof should retain their distinct evidentiary roles.
Accessibility, privacy, local-first resilience, and exportable learner records are preferred design properties.
Shared infrastructure must not become a single point of failure for course access.
Public educational interfaces should not expose private implementation architecture.

sharedAcademicClouds.purpose: Expose public-safe current learning context across subjects and stages.
Match approved public learning resources to subject, stage, lesson, evidence mode, and accessibility needs.
mustNot: treat resource availability as academic endorsement without course context

sharedAcademicClouds.purpose: Preserve distinctions among scores, learner work, sources, observations, calculations, experiments, arguments, proofs, and reflections.
mustNot: merge unlike evidence types into a misleading status

sharedAcademicClouds.purpose: Support learner progression and portable records across schools and subjects without replacing the central identity authority.

subjectContract.gracefulFallback: Courses remain usable when shared subject or academic metadata is unavailable.

courseContract.permanentIdRule: A course uses one permanent courseId across lessons, assessments, exports, labs, evidence records, and resource discovery.
courseContract.masteryHonesty: A course may only certify the forms of mastery its evidence actually supports.
courseContract.learnerVoice: Learner-created reasoning and work should remain distinguishable from mentor, tool, or source contributions.

referenceImplementation.title: Advanced Geometric Topology, Global Geometry & Mathematical Physics
referenceImplementation.purpose: First end-to-end reference course used to validate shared academic architecture at the furthest current mathematics level.
